extracted.name: Rosita
extracted.description: If you love negronis, you’ll enjoy this twist that replaces the gin with tequila – it's a punchy drink made with Campari and red vermouth
ingredient_lines: pared lemon or grapefruit zest, to garnish
instruction_lines: Put the tequila, Campari, vermouth, ice and citrus peel in a tumbler glass.
Stir with a cocktail spoon until the outside of the glass feels cold and the ice is well incorporated into the drink. Taste to check the dilution before serving (see tip, below).
